entities.summary: Hermann Johann Heinrich Behrends was a Nazi Party member and SS official with the rank of SS-Gruppenführer and Generalleutnant of police. He served as a Higher SS and Police Leader in Yugoslavia during the Second World War and was tried and executed in Belgrade for war crimes.
